plan_items.title: Create Plan Table UI
plan_items.description: Design and implement a generic Plan Table UI that displays plan items created by the Plan agent. Table columns: id, title, description, status, owner, due_date, priority, tags.

plan_items.title: Ensure Plan agent emits JSON
plan_items.description: Update the Plan agent so finalized plans include a machine-readable 'plan_items' JSON object that the UI can consume.

plan_items.title: Add backend GET /api/plan_items
plan_items.description: Serve sample plan_items JSON from docs/plan_items_examples.json for local UI development. Provide a read-only endpoint used only in dev.

plan_items.title: Create sample plan variants
plan_items.description: Provide examples covering pending, in_progress, done, and blocked statuses with null owners and dates to exercise UI edge cases.

plan_items.title: Finalize and merge Plan Table
plan_items.description: Complete integration, tests, and documentation for Plan Table UI and merge to main branch.

plan_items.title: Blocked: external API access
plan_items.description: Blocked until external Copilot Space rendering permissions are approved.
